'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC Artisan interested in Rover's [[Expedition Motorbike]] in [[Xuanfang Hold]], [[Mengzhou]] region. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Shuohuan:''' Hello there. Heard from the Foreign Affairs Bureau you've got one of those Spacetrek Collective expedition bikes?

==Dialogue==
:'''Shuohuan:''' Hello there. Heard from the Foreign Affairs Bureau you've got one of those Spacetrek Collective expedition bikes?

:'''Shuohuan:''' Mind if I take a look at it? Please, just one glance.

:{{DIcon}} (Show your motorbike.)

:'''Shuohuan:''' The engineering on this is... very sophisticated. I've only ever seen something like this in the Pioneer Association's archives.

:'''Shuohuan:''' Ah, I was involved in the production for our current generation of Cloud Rides. I heard the Spacetrek Collective had similar vehicles, so I got curious.

:{{DIcon}} Current generation?

:'''Shuohuan:''' Yes, Cloud Rides have been in service in Xuanfang for over a century. What you're using now is actually a newer model, improved over the years by Huaxu and the Ministry of Development.

:'''Shuohuan:''' The look and structure incorporate popular design elements today. And the ride's a lot more comfortable too.

:{{DIcon}} So it's been around for that long, huh?

:'''Shuohuan:''' That's right. Hmm... the original prototype probably dates all the way back to when Xuanfang Hold was first built.

:'''Shuohuan:''' Legend says the craftsman who invented it had the character {{Rubi|"Yun"|Cloud}} in their name.
{{Dialogue End}}
